title: 又 con negación: inferencia y acomodación

claimAssessments.claim: Xue and Jiang (2023) analyze a quasi-logical use of 又 in naturally occurring conversation. For the construction [又 + negation + right conjunct], they argue that the logical and presuppositional meanings do not yield a coherent reading on their own; the listener accommodates an implicit conditional premise to infer the utterance. They locate the inference in the construction, not in 又 alone. This is an account of accommodation and pragmatic inference, not evidence that the ordinary ‘again’ presupposition is freely cancelable.
